title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount | Matte Black | Solid Brass Hardware | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount, Matte Black
description:
Clear counter clutter and keep everyday essentials organized with a space-saving, wall-mounted glass shelf designed for modern bathrooms in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

Highlights:
- Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, minimalist look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate your space with modern bathroom hardware made to pair with contemporary bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 15 inches H
- Glass thickness: 0.38 inch (3/8-inch)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw installation (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware
available in multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
